title: Box 7 at the Flower Market
synopsis: The Owl's route ends at the flower market.
Box 7 holds a bag of strange white dust.
And the flower seller saw something on Thursday night.
goal: Open Box 7 and find out what Pia saw on Thursday night.

play.title: Pia's Morning
story: The flower stall with the red roof is full of roses.
A cheerful woman in a flowered apron waves at you.
play.letter:
6:30 — The baker bought red roses.
5:45 — I opened my stall.
11:00 — Giulia came with a detective!
6:10 — A young woman put a bag in Box 7. She had an owl ring.
play.question: Put Pia's morning in order, from the earliest time.
hints: The earliest time is the smallest one.
play.successMessage: You put Pia's morning in order!
transition: Pia opened at 5:45. The woman with the owl ring came at 6:10.
"So the Owl is a young woman," says Giulia.
Pia points to a small wooden box with a 7 on it.
play.orderFeedback: Look at the times again. Start with the earliest.

play.title: Inside Box 7
story: Inside, you find a small bag of white dust and an owl card.
play.letter:
Detective, smell this dust.
Old marble does not smell of anything.
This dust smells new, like a wet wall.
It is not from the real piece.
Ask Pia about Thursday night.
Then go where the roof has a round eye.
— The Owl
play.question: The dust is not from the real piece. What could it be from?
hints: Old marble smells of nothing. Is this dust old or new?

transition: New dust, like a wet wall. Maybe someone made a copy of the piece!
"Thursday night?" says Pia. "Oh, I remember Thursday night."

play.title: Thursday Night
story: Pia sits down on a crate of lemons.
"I closed late on Thursday," she says.
"I saw a man. I can tell you what he wore."
play.letter:
PIA'S STORY:
On Thursday night, I closed my stall at 11:30.
A big man walked past with a heavy box.
He came from the road to the museum.
He wore a yellow helmet.
On the helmet was a picture of a tall machine.
It lifts heavy things up high.

MY GRANDSON'S TOY BOX:
TRAIN — it runs on tracks.
CRANE — it lifts heavy things up high.
BOAT — it floats on water.
play.question: What was the picture on the man's helmet?
play.prompt: The helmet had a ____ on it.
hints: Read what the machine on the helmet does.
Find the toy that does the same thing.
transition: A big man, a yellow helmet with a crane, a heavy box.
And he came from the museum road on Thursday night!
"Wait," says Pia. "He dropped something. I locked it in my cash box."

feedback.TRAIN: A train runs on tracks. What lifts heavy things?
feedback.BOAT: A boat floats on water. What lifts heavy things up high?

play.orderFeedback: Check your spelling in the toy box list.

play.title: Pia's Cash Box
story: Pia's cash box has three dials.
"I always forget my code," she laughs. "So I wrote questions!"
play.letter:
MY CODE:
First: How many people came to my stall before the detective this morning?
Second: Which day of the week is Thursday? Monday is day 1.
Third: The number of the Owl's box.
play.question: Turn the dials to Pia's three numbers. Then open the cash box.
hints: Read Pia's order book again. Count only people.
Count the days: Monday 1, Tuesday 2, and so on.
transition: Pia puts the pass in your hand.
Giulia reads the Owl's card again: go where the roof has a round eye.
"A roof with an eye... that is the Pantheon!"

feedback.246: Look at the key's tag again. What is the box's number?
feedback.257: Count the days again: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday.
feedback.347: Count only people. Opening the stall is not a person.

play.orderFeedback: Good numbers, wrong places. People first, then the day, then the box.

evidence.name: The Dropped Pass
evidence.description: A museum pass the man in the yellow helmet dropped on Thursday night.

ending.text: Two, four, seven! My cash box is open!

ending.text: Inside is a museum pass. It says THURSDAY.

ending.text: Find him, Detective. And find that young woman, too!

hook: Who dropped a museum pass on Thursday night?

intro: Campo de' Fiori is a busy market.
There are flowers, lemons and loud voices everywhere.
At the end of the square is a flower stall with a red roof.
play.caseSummary: The Owl is a young woman with an owl ring. She left a bag of new white dust in Box 7. On Thursday night, Pia saw a big man with a heavy box. He wore a yellow helmet with a crane, and he dropped a museum pass.

notes: The dropped pass (s3_ep03_e4) proves Bruno was at the museum on Thursday: Case 11.
The crane helmet (s3_ep03_c3) is matched in Case 06 (the builder) and Case 10 (the helmet's name).
STEP 3-14: puzzles kept; Pia's talks, Discovery Moments and an ending added. A picture choice for the helmet was weighed and left to Case 10, where the helmet is found.
